description: Read one company-brain page's full contents, as markdown. Read the page before editing it — edit_wiki_page replaces an exact string, and the ## Sources section at the bottom has to be kept current.

page_id.description: The page's full id, as returned by get_wiki_tree, search_wiki or create_wiki_page. Not the 8-character short id — those address motions, not pages.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: read_wiki_page
